title: Beyond Correct Answers: How Compositional Cues Shape Visual Judgments
abstract: arXiv:2610.28843v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual question answering requires models to assign attributes and relations to the correct objects, a problem known as visual binding. Structured prompts make these assignments explicit through labeled fields. Yet an improvement from the full prompt does not reveal which labels help or how they interact. First, we isolate field-label effects across ten models and six tasks by holding the image and claim fixed. These comparisons reveal differences that overall accuracy can hide. With a relation label present, adding object-role labels helps Qwen3 but hurts Qwen2 on Spatial. Second, we compare auxiliary hints that preserve or swap the question's role assignments against a no-hint baseline. Across two image sets, Qwen3's advantage with preserving hints mainly reflects errors caused by swapped hints. Preserving hints remain near baseline. Field order further affects the harm. translated_title: 超越正确答案：组合线索如何塑造视觉判断
translated_abstract: 视觉问答要求模型将属性和关系正确分配给相应的对象，这一问题被称为视觉绑定。结构化提示通过带标签的字段使这些分配显式化。然而，完整提示带来的改进并不能揭示哪些标签有帮助，以及它们之间如何相互作用。首先，我们通过固定图像和陈述，在十个模型和六个任务上分离出各字段标签的影响。这些比较揭示了总体准确率所能隐藏的差异：在存在关系标签的情况下，添加对象角色标签对Qwen3在空间任务上有帮助，但对Qwen2却有害。其次，我们将保留或交换问题角色分配的辅助提示与无提示基线进行比较。在两个图像集上，Qwen3在保留提示下的优势主要反映了交换提示所导致的错误，而保留提示的效果仍接近基线水平，字段顺序还会进一步影响这种危害。第三，我们测试了更清晰的提示措辞以及直接选择……
tldr: 该论文通过控制变量方法系统解构结构化提示中各字段标签对视觉绑定任务的影响，发现标签效果因模型而异，且Qwen3在保留提示下的优势主要源于交换提示导致的错误。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically isolates the effects of individual field labels in structured prompts on visual binding across ten models and six tasks, revealing model-specific differences and showing that Qwen3's advantage with preserving hints mainly reflects errors caused by swapped hints.
